title: agentgate.lock
description: AgentGate lockfile: pins the exact MCP tool surface (tool names, descriptions, input schemas) an agent is approved to see. All hashes are lowercase hex SHA-256. Input schemas are hashed over their canonical JSON form (object keys sorted recursively, no whitespace).

generatedBy.description: Tool and version that generated this lockfile, e.g. "mcp-agentgate@0.1.0".

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 generation timestamp. Informational only; not part of drift comparison.

servers.description: Locked tool surface per MCP server, keyed by the server name from the client config.

surfaceHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON array of [nameHash, descriptionHash, inputSchemaHash] triples of all tools, sorted by tool name.

name.description: Tool name (kept in plaintext for readable diffs).

nameHash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 tool name.

descriptionHash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 tool description (empty string if absent).

inputSchemaHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the tool input schema ({} if absent).
